internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards Nerts page in a browser. "Players play simultaneously as fast as they like, not taking turns, moving cards around their own tableau building on the foundations in the common area." Codex rechecked the complete official HTML rules on 2026-10-20 under the owner's indexing-recovery authorization. The Play still explicitly describes simultaneous play without turns. A first-player tie or random starter is therefore inapplicable; explicit presentation flags remove those generic suggestions while preserving the approved answer and source scope. The source separately resolves simultaneous attempts to play to one foundation, including an unresolved collision tie; that is an in-game rule, not a starting-player tie.
